title: Nourishing Uruguayan Corn Wrap
description: A quick, diabetic-friendly wrap featuring corn tortillas, shio-cure soy sauce, and fresh fillings.
instructions: Warm the corn tortillas in a dry skillet over medium heat for 30 seconds each side.
In a bowl, combine shredded chicken, corn kernels, diced avocado, diced red onion, and shredded lettuce.
Whisk together shio-cure soy sauce, lime juice, and olive oil to make the dressing.
Drizzle the dressing over the chicken mixture and toss until evenly coated.
Spoon the mixture onto the warmed tortillas, sprinkling shredded cheese and chopped cilantro on top.
Fold the sides of the tortilla over the filling and roll tightly to form a wrap.
Place the wrapped tortillas seam side down and cook in the skillet for 2 minutes, flipping once, until the cheese melts.
Remove from skillet, slice in half diagonally, and serve immediately.
